articles.title: National Urban Governance Reform Framework 2026
articles.summary: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs launches updated guidelines to empower Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) under the 74th Constitutional Amendment.
prelims: 74th Constitutional Amendment Act mandates local self-governance in urban areas.
Devolution of 18 functional domain items listed under the 12th Schedule.
State Finance Commissions (SFCs) review the financial position of municipalities periodically.
articles.mains: Use as a contemporary example of structural reforms aimed at fiscal decentralization, municipal cadre capacity building, and strengthening democratic decentralization in India.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: Matsya 6000 Final Deep-Sea Test Trials
articles.summary: India's indigenous crewed submersible completes crucial deep-sea trial phases, advancing national seabed exploration capabilities.
prelims: Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
Designed to carry 3 humans to a depth of 6,000 meters in the ocean.
Aims to explore Polymetallic Nodules rich in critical minerals like nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese.
articles.mains: Cite in answers related to India's Blue Economy policy, critical mineral security, oceanographic research, and indigenous technology development.

articles.title: Implementation Roadmap of India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement
articles.summary: Detailed guidelines released for tracking the $100 billion investment commitment under the India-EFTA TEPA.
prelims: EFTA includes four non-EU European nations: Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein.
First Indian FTA with a target-linked investment and job-creation commitment.
Sensitive sectors such as domestic agriculture and dairy are excluded from major tariff concessions.
articles.mains: Valuable illustration of modern bilateral Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) that integrate foreign direct investment targets alongside merchandise trade.

articles.title: Climate Mitigation in Agriculture and Methane Footprint Reduction
articles.summary: ICAR report advocates for System of Rice Intensification (SRI) and alternate wetting and drying to reduce agricultural greenhouse gases.
prelims: Methane has a short-term Global Warming Potential (GWP) significantly higher than carbon dioxide.
Global Methane Pledge targets a 30% global reduction in methane emissions by 2030 from 2020 levels.
India is not a signatory to the Global Methane Pledge to protect smallholder farmer livelihoods.
articles.mains: Use to highlight the trade-offs between international climate pledges, national food security, and agrarian sustainable farming methods.

articles.title: RBI Mandatory Climate Risk Disclosure Norms for Regulated Entities
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India mandates standardized climate-related financial risk disclosures for major banks and NBFCs.
prelims: Applies to Commercial Banks, All-India Financial Institutions (AIFIs), and top-tier NBFCs.
Framework aligned with global standards set by the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD).
Focuses on four core pillars: Governance, Strategy, Risk Management, and Metrics/Targets.
articles.mains: Relevant for questions on green banking, systemic macroeconomic stability, ESG compliance, and managing financial transition risks in India.
